cmake_minimum_required(VERSION 3.25)
project(write_observer_link LANGUAGES CXX)
set(CMAKE_CXX_STANDARD 20)
set(CMAKE_CXX_STANDARD_REQUIRED ON)
set(CMAKE_CXX_VISIBILITY_PRESET hidden)
find_package(Threads REQUIRED)
get_filename_component(KICAD_ROOT "${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}/../../../.." ABSOLUTE)
add_library(observer_provider SHARED "${KICAD_ROOT}/common/file_write_observer.cpp")
target_include_directories(observer_provider PUBLIC "${KICAD_ROOT}/include")
target_compile_definitions(observer_provider PRIVATE KICOMMON_DLL)
add_executable(observer_consumer consumer.cpp)
target_link_libraries(observer_consumer PRIVATE observer_provider Threads::Threads)
if(MSVC)
    add_library(rejected_tls_interface SHARED EXCLUDE_FROM_ALL rejected_tls_interface.cpp)
    add_executable(observer_missing_provider EXCLUDE_FROM_ALL consumer.cpp)
    target_include_directories(observer_missing_provider PRIVATE "${KICAD_ROOT}/include")
    target_link_libraries(observer_missing_provider PRIVATE Threads::Threads)
endif()
